title: Wander VPS (visual positioning) contracts
description: Payloads for the self-hosted mapping + image-query localization service (`/worlds/{id}/vps/*`, services/backend). Mapping follows ACE (Brachmann et al., CVPR 2023): a frozen pretrained encoder plus a per-world scene-coordinate regression head trained from posed RGB frames; localization regresses dense 2D->3D correspondences for a single query image and solves PnP-RANSAC for a 6DoF pose in the map frame. The map frame is the ARKit world frame of the capture that produced the map (metres, +Y up, right-handed).

rotation.description: How the client rotated the landscape sensor image before encoding it. `cw90` is what the iOS FrameEncoder does (`.oriented(.right)`) to produce a portrait upload.

frame.description: One posed RGB frame - exactly what `NianticRESTTransport` (apps/ios) posts, plus optional sensor hints. `intrinsics` and `cameraTransform` are the raw ARKit values for the *sensor* image; the server folds `rotation` and the sensor->upload resize into them.

imageWidth.description: Width of the uploaded (rotated, resized) image.

cameraTransform.description: ARCamera.transform (camera->ARKit world, OpenGL axes). Required for mapping frames; optional for queries - when present the response includes `mapFromSession`.

sensorWidth.description: ARCamera.imageResolution width. Inferred from the principal point when omitted.

mapId.description: Defaults to the world's active map.

mapping.description: Overrides for services/backend `MappingOptions` (image_height, buffer_size, samples_per_image, batch_size, epochs, learning rates, head_blocks, augmentation, ...).

localization.description: Overrides for `LocalizationOptions` stored with the map (max_reproj_error_px, min_inlier_count, min_inlier_ratio, RANSAC iteration bounds, ...).

stats.description: Filled when ready: frames, buffer_samples, epochs, train_seconds, final_loss, loss_curve, scene_center, ...

phase.description: queued | loading | buffer | train | export | done | error

localized.description: False when PnP-RANSAC found fewer inliers than the map's `min_inlier_count` / `min_inlier_ratio`; the pose fields are then null.

correspondences.description: Number of regressed 2D->3D correspondences (one per 8x8 feature cell).

pose.description: 6DoF camera pose in the map (ARKit world) frame: position [x,y,z] metres + rotation quaternion [x,y,z,w].

cameraToMap.description: Same pose as a camera->map ARKit-convention transform, ready to compare with ARCamera.transform.

mapFromSession.description: map <- current ARKit session transform (= cameraToMap * inverse(cameraTransform)). Null when the query had no `cameraTransform`. Apply it to subsequent ARKit poses to keep tracking in the map frame between VPS fixes.
